title: WWF-India EIACP launches nationwide Green Diwali Campaign from 20th October to 8th November 2026; Urges Citizens to celebrate a Cracker-free Diwali
body_text:
WWF-India’s Programme Centre – Resource Partner (PC-RP),  supported by Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, has launched a nationwide Green Diwali Campaign from 20.10.2026 to 08.11.2026, urging citizens to avoid firecrackers and celebrate a clean and green Diwali in line with Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment). The campaign will reach schools, colleges, educational institutions, resident welfare associations and local communities, with a special focus on the 130 cities covered under the National Clean Air Programme (NCAP).
As part of the campaign, citizens are encouraged to take the Green Diwali Pledge to avoid firecrackers, encourage family and neighbours to do the same, use diyas and energy-efficient lights, avoid single-use plastic, segregate waste and choose local products. Educational institutions and community groups are encouraged to organise pledge drives during assemblies, classes, rallies and community meetings.
Citizens are also encouraged to take WWF-India’s Carbon Footprint Survey to understand how their daily activities and consumption contribute to their environmental footprint and identify more sustainable habits. The survey is available at: https://wwfindiawebgis.in/Carbon_Footprint/Carbon_Footprint.html . Schools, colleges, EIACP centres, community groups and individuals participating in the campaign are requested to share details of their activities through the online form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/15hDbjbqZzeo68kNjAxeHQA_SMIQ7lUlPdvCIi-gvwdY/viewform .
Submissions should include the institution or organisation’s name and location, activity details and date, the number of participants who took the pledge, geo-tagged photographs and a brief report. Selected entries may be featured on EIACP websites and social media platforms.
